443. 3-Length Subsets

Problem Statement:
You are given a small string not more then 10 characters and distinct characters. You are required to generate all the character subsets of length 3.
input_spec: The only line of input is a string S.
output_spec:
Print the number of subsets of length three, N, on the first line.
Print N lines printing the subsets in alphabetical/lexicographical order.
Note: If a character S[i] appears before S[j] in S, S[i] should occur before S[j] in each subset too. Print 0 if no cases are formed (for all valid i and j)
